value: select xm,mz,substr(csny,1,7)||'('||cast(strftime('%Y.%m',datetime('now'))-substr(csny,1,7) as INTEGER)||')' as csnyStr,xrz,CASE WHEN allRzsjList IS NOT NULL AND allRzsjList != '' THEN allRzsjList ELSE '' END as zjStr,a.CadreID as _photo_id,zwjb,a.CadreID as _id from tb_cadre_node as b left outer join tb_cadre as a on a.CadreID=b.ZwCadreID where zwjb in("正县","副县","正处","副处") group by cadreid order by dwID,zwOrder
